shared_elements: upright rectangular slab with framed/bordered field
horizontal band of repeated marks across the upper part
a rounded/disc-like element in the field
low-relief carving with linear incised detail
justification: Both are upright framed slabs with a horizontal band of small repeated marks near the top and curvilinear plant-like forms filling the field, but that is close to generic. A depicts a specific narrative figure — a winged bird-headed anthropomorph in profile with raised hand and bucket beside naturalistic flowering plants — whereas B is wholly non-figural, dominated by an interlaced knot within a disc flanked by symmetrical spiral scrolls, so the subject matter, relationships and drawing conventions are entirely different.
